BC_description: The web-vitals library has changed the order of classes in attribution selectors to sort class names alphabetically. This change affects the format of element selectors in attribution data. Previously, class names appeared in the order they were defined in the HTML, but now they are sorted alphabetically, which affects the string representation of selectors returned by the internal getSelector() function used in attribution data.
Adaptation_method: Update any code that relies on the specific order of classes in attribution selectors. For example, if you previously had an element with classes 'foo bar baz', the selector would have been '.foo.bar.baz'. After this change, it would be '.bar.baz.foo' (alphabetically sorted). Any string matching, parsing, or comparison logic that depends on the exact format of these selectors needs to be updated to handle the alphabetically sorted class names.
